# Proposed traditional generator set for the level-6 sector (generated by tools/make_genset.py)

Notation: w = e^{i pi/3}; Li_n(x) = sum_k x^k/k^n; Cl_n(t) = Im Li_n(e^{it}) (n even); Li_{a1..ar}(x1..xr) = sum_{k1>..>kr>=1} prod x_i^{k_i}/k_i^{a_i};
Ls_j^{(k)}(t) = -int_0^t phi^k ln^{j-1-k}|2 sin(phi/2)| dphi.  Weight 1: ln 2, ln 3 (Re), pi (Im).  Each weight/parity block, together
with all products of lower-weight generators of matching parity, is a basis of that piece of the complete level-6 space (dims Re/Im
5/3, 12/9, 30/25, 76/68, 195/182 at weights 2..6).  Evaluation routines: M: PARI zeta(n) / mpmath.zeta; C: PARI polylog(n,x) / mpmath.polylog(n,x) (Cl_n: mpmath.clsin(n,pi/3)); L: mpmath.quad of the defining integral; exact G-function form in tools/trad.py (Symbolica/GiNaC GPL, g6); D2: Symbolica GPL evaluator (as vakint GPLReal/GPLImag) / GiNaC G() / tools/g6.py; P: Symbolica GPL evaluator / GiNaC G() / tools/g6.py
